content: Tutor/instructor session-logging tools (TutorLog, Timesheet, Tutoring Tracker, Teachworks, Poolva Coach, TutorTally) cluster around: per-student hour totals, session log with date/duration/topic/homework/notes, weekly/monthly stats, CSV export, on-device journals, and paid one-tap parent progress PDF. Teachworks has a per-lesson mileage field. No surveyed app combined receipt photos with travel-time logging. Vendor marketing claims, unverified.
